verdict.rationale: Brave ships an official MCP server plus guides for Claude Desktop, Open WebUI, n8n, Dify, OpenClaw and 'Skills' for Cursor/Copilot/Codex/etc., and a dedicated LLM Context endpoint explicitly built for machine/tool consumption — strong evidence of ready-made agent-framework tool integration. However, no OpenAPI/function-calling schema was found (probe returned 404s for openapi.json/swagger.json), and community reporting shows the standard/free plan's ToS explicitly prohibits using responses for AI inference, requiring a separate AI Inference plan for agent use — a real practical caveat on 'plug-and-play' tool use. Missing for 10: published OpenAPI/function-calling JSON schema, and clarity/first-party confirmation resolving the ToS friction for standard-tier agent use.
